title: End-to-End Lead Nurture Funnel in HubSpot
summary: A hands-free HubSpot workflow that thanks every new lead, waits, reads their behaviour and either nurtures them or hands them to sales with a task already created.
challenge: Leads were downloading resources and filling in forms, then hearing nothing for days. Sales had no signal for who was warm, so follow-up depended on someone remembering to check the CRM.
approach: I mapped the buyer journey from first form fill to opportunity and turned it into a single enrolment-triggered workflow. A two-day delay gives the lead time to explore, then an if/then branch checks page views. Engaged contacts trigger a follow-up task for sales; quieter contacts get a value-first email instead of a hard pitch. A workflow goal of 'Opportunity created' lets the team measure the funnel instead of guessing.
